services.desc: The benefits of regular massage are both physical and mental. Massage helps transform your body as well as calm your mind. Clinical evidence shows that regular massage can improve sleep, prevent depression, lower stress and leave you feeling fresh and energized. Hot Stone Massage is a type of massage therapy used to help you relax, and ease tense muscles and damaged soft tissue throughout your body. During a Hot Stone Massage, heated stones are used to massage and relieve tension, while healing pain and stress in specific parts of your body.
